summary: Comprehensive test of BookShelf web app (React + FastAPI + MongoDB). Backend: 19/19 pytest tests PASS (auth, multi-source search incl. DNB, cover endpoint, stats periods + fallback, books filters series=__none__/rating, overview series_none+covers_missing, series canonicalization, import CSV job + duplicate skip, invalid ZIP → 400, enrich/covers|series|all jobs, GET /api/jobs/unknown → 404). Frontend: all key testIDs & flows work on mobile viewport 390x844 – Library row-series-none shows 'Einzelne Bücher'; Auffrischen row-fix-covers & row-detect-series trigger a job with job-progress → 'Fertig'; Stats period chips (month/quarter/year/all) switch data; rating-row-5 is clickable → rating-books-5 + rating-all-5 href '/books?rating=5'; no bad time formats (no '8h 60m'); Calendar spans contain only cover images (no title text); /books has exactly ONE list-filters row with all six expected chips (filter-all-all, filter-read-{read,unread}, filter-ownership-{owned,borrowed,not_owned}); /books?rating=5 shows '5 Sterne' header; BookDetail progress-card + reading-card-toggle expand/collapse, progress-finish opens finish-sheet, start-reading navigates to /books/:id/read with timer-clock/toggle/wake/end working, timer-end opens end-session-sheet with ring/page-±/mark-finished/save, end-save navigates back and shows 'Lesezeit gespeichert' toast; add-book-button opens book-form, form-find-cover works, form-submit saves book; /settings/import renders kindle-links/tolino-links/copy-kindle-script and import-csv-file upload triggers job-progress with '1 Bücher importiert' toast.

ui_bugs.issue: React validateDOMNesting warning – a <button> (Stars) is rendered inside another <button> (RatingRow). Invalid HTML, triggers console error on every stats render.

action_items: Fix nested <button> inside <button> in RatingRows/Stars (frontend/src/components/stats or pages/StatsPage.jsx around RatingRows). Either render the Stars as non-button span/div (role='img') or hoist the Stars click out of the row button.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend routers are focused and <300 lines each – OK.
search.py merges Google/OpenLibrary/DNB cleanly with dedup + fuzzy fallback.
stats.py uses safe_date and dict comprehension for by_rating – correct contract.
Note: /api/search endpoint is auth-protected (good). Rate limits for Google Books (429) are correctly absorbed by OpenLibrary/DNB fallback.
Minor: /api/search/cover accepts no caching layer; repeated calls hit upstream every time. Acceptable for now.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all listed testIDs + flows verified; one HTML nesting warning)

seed_data_creation: Transient test books (TESTUI_*, TESTJOB_*, TESTDUP_*) created and cleaned up afterwards. Fourth Wing current_page bumped from ~120 to 123 by timer-end save (minor seed drift, user book 3d985ff9... still status=reading).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials: lara.test@example.com / test1234. Token saved to localStorage.bs_token for UI tests. Backend URL in frontend/.env is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (same host). Expo supervisor runs craco dev server (not real Expo). DNB & OpenLibrary reachable, Google Books returns 429 but fallback masks it. Jobs usually finish within <5s for small payloads but allow up to 60s. Fourth Wing current_page is now 123 (not 120) due to timer-save test.
rca_of_issue: Nested button DOM warning: RatingRows renders each rating as a <button> that includes a <Stars> component which itself renders a <button>. Browsers tolerate it, but React logs a validateDOMNesting warning. No functional impact – clicks still fire – but should be cleaned up for a11y.
